# Vendored third-party code

| Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dear ImGui | 1.93.0 WIP (+ SDL2 / OpenGL3 backends) | MIT | https://github.com/ocornut/imgui |
| stb_image, stb_image_write, stb_image_resize2 | current master | MIT / public domain | https://github.com/nothings/stb |
| miniz | 3.0.2 | MIT | https://github.com/richgel999/miniz |
| md4c | 0.5.2 | MIT | https://github.com/mity/md4c |
| nlohmann/json | 3.x | MIT | https://github.com/nlohmann/json |
| cpp-httplib | 0.18.3 | MIT | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib |

System libraries linked at build time: SDL2 (zlib license), libcurl (curl
license), libxml2 (MIT), zlib (zlib license), OpenSSL (Apache 2.0).

The UI theme and the preferences code were ported from the author's own
weatherDesktop and k-os client projects and are MIT here.
